- 11 × 101 = 1111
- 1111 × 1001 = 1,112,111

- 11,122,222,111 × 100001 = 1,112,233,333,322,111, whose last 8 digits are 33,322,111.
- Multiplying by 1000001 adds N·10⁶, where N is the running value. Modulo 10⁸ only the last two digits of N matter, giving 33,322,111 + 11·10⁶ = 44,322,111.
- 44,322,111 × 111 = 4,919,754,321, whose last 8 digits are 19,754,321.
